purpose: royal edict forbidding the entry of officials from the śolla and liṅgvala offices into a pañcālī
notes: The inscription is heavily damaged and fragmentary (R. 114; HJ 105). The issuing king's name is broken and lost in lacunae (only fragments such as '...rmana... kulaketunā ... rājā' in line 4 and '...śrīvarmareva' in line 9 survive), leaving no identifiable individuals or date.
